dedupe_keys.name: syctom environmental open data daily stack emissions and fallout monitoring of the paris area waste to energy plants saint ouen isseane ivry paris xiii

description: This open data space publishes the measured emissions of the three large plants that burn the household waste of Paris and its surrounding municipalities to recover energy. It is published by Syctom, the public agency that treats household waste for Paris and surrounding municipalities, as part of its transparency commitments. Coverage is the Saint-Ouen (L'Etoile Verte), Isséane and Ivry-Paris XIII plants, with annual workbooks from 2020 per furnace and daily emission records for the Ivry furnaces from 2021 to 2025, plus fallout monitoring with deposition gauges from 2017 and biomonitoring of dioxins and metals with mosses and lichens around each site. A separate section publishes financial data. All files are free and available to download as Excel workbooks from the Syctom website. Caveats: files follow each plant's own layout, no tonnage or energy output series was seen on the environmental page, and no open licence is named. Simulation uses: parameterising furnace availability and emission constraints in urban waste treatment and district energy models, and checking the operating pattern of waste-to-energy plants. Related records: the China incineration monitoring data (data-china-msw-incineration-monitoring) is a larger continuous-emissions source, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives national treatment totals.
